About the song : "Tribute to Sidhu Moose Wala" is a heartfelt homage from Emiway Bantai to the legend Shubhdeep Singh Sidhu, famously known as Sidhu Moose Wala.
This tribute is a sincere remembrance of Sidhu and his enduring legacy. Legends Live Forever!
Audio credits:
Song : Tribute To Sidhu Moosewala
Performed & Written by : Emiway Bantai
Produced by : Tony James
Mix & Mastered by : tejmixedit
